title: Vladislav Ursu visits ATTP
body_html:
Multiple Republic of Moldova table tennis champion and qualified participant in the 2024 Olympic Games (Paris), International Master of Sport and ATTP member Vladislav URSU honoured us with a visit to the ATTP venue in Chișinău.

Despite his young age, this charismatic young man is by right the most successful table tennis player in the country’s entire history. He is the pride of Moldova, of his family and of the whole table tennis community in the country

In a friendly conversation with association members and old friends, he shared many interesting stories about his road to sporting glory, recalled important past wins and tournaments and, of course, gave the lads an enormous boost of motivation to keep going and to continue developing and promoting the sport among young people.
